_comment: Copy this file to deploy.config.json and fill it in. deploy.config.json is gitignored - never commit real credentials. Used by scripts/deploy.mjs (npm run deploy / deploy:nobuild / deploy:dry). Any value can also be supplied as an env var of the same name in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE (e.g. FTP_PASSWORD) which wins over this file, for CI.
_secure: FTPS mode. true = explicit FTPS on port 21 (recommended, Plesk default). "implicit" = implicit FTPS (usually port 990). false = plain unencrypted FTP.
_tlsStrict: Verify the FTP server's TLS certificate. Shared/Plesk hosts often present a cert that doesn't match the hostname - leave false unless you know the FTP endpoint has a valid cert for `host`.
_remoteDir: Remote directory, relative to THIS FTP account's home (Plesk has already pinned it to /portal.attlarp.gr). "/" means the site's web root. Only change to deploy into a subfolder of it.
